title: Find the full names of members who have incurred expenses in more than one
question: Find the full names of members who have incurred expenses in more than one budget category and whose total spending exceeds the average amount spent on 'Food' in closed events.

prediction.sql:
WITH food_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(b.XCL_005) AS avg_food
  FROM budget b
  JOIN event e ON b.XCL_009 = e.XCL_010
  WHERE b.XCL_004 = 'Food' AND e.XCL_016 = 'Closed'
),
member_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    m.XCL_034 AS member_id,
    m.XCL_035 AS first_name,
    m.XCL_036 AS last_name,
    SUM(e.XCL_020) AS total_spending,
    COUNT(DISTINCT b.XCL_004) AS category_count
  FROM member m
  JOIN expense e ON m.XCL_034 = e.XCL_022
  JOIN budget b ON e.XCL_023 = b.XCL_003
  GROUP BY m.XCL_034, m.XCL_035, m.XCL_036
)
SELECT ms.first_name, ms.last_name
FROM member_stats ms
CROSS JOIN food_avg fa
WHERE ms.category_count > 1 AND ms.total_spending > fa.avg_food

),
